verdict.rationale: A code-hosting forge could plausibly ship built-in AI features that consume external MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows Gitea acting as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence is an official Gitea MCP server (gitea-mcp), which exposes Gitea to other agents. That is the server role, which belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
